t2.title: University education be free for everyone
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should university education be free for everyone?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Finding Your Path to Language Fluency

With countless language learning methods available, students often wonder which approach is most effective. While there is no single answer, certain strategies consistently produce results.

Firstly, immersion is widely considered the most powerful method. Surrounding yourself with the language through media, conversations, and travel accelerates learning dramatically.

However, not everyone can travel abroad. In such cases, consistent daily practice is essential. Even 20 minutes daily produces better results than occasional intensive sessions.

Moreover, combining methods works best. Formal classes provide structure, while apps offer flexibility. Speaking with native speakers develops fluency that textbooks alone cannot achieve.

Additionally, learning should be enjoyable. Watching films or reading books in the target language makes practice feel less like work.

Ultimately, the best method is one you will actually stick with. Motivation and consistency matter more than any specific technique.

t2.sampleA2:

t2.sampleB1:
Hi everyone,

I think that university education should be free for everyone. I believe this because education is very important for people to get good jobs and improve their lives. If university is free, more people can go, even if they don't have much money.

For example, in my country, many people cannot afford to go to university, and this is not fair. However, I also understand that it might be difficult for the government to pay for everything. Maybe they could find a way to make it cheaper, so more people can go.

In my opinion, education is a right, not a privilege. Thanks for reading.
t2.sampleB2: Hi everyone, This is a really interesting question, and it's one I've been thinking about a lot lately, so I'd love to hear what you all think. Personally, I lean towards making university free, at least up to a point. Education shouldn't come down to how much money your family has. When talented young people are priced out of higher education, society loses out on future doctors, engineers and teachers. Free tuition would level the playing field and give everyone a fair shot. That said, I can see the other side of the argument. Universities are expensive to run, and someone has to foot the bill. If the government covers everything, taxes will almost certainly go up, and some people feel that's unfair on those who never attend. For me, the answer lies somewhere in the middle. Perhaps free places could go to the students who need them most, funded through scholarships and grants. That way, nobody misses out because of their background, and the system stays affordable for taxpayers too. What do you all reckon? Is completely free education realistic, or just wishful thinking? I'd love to read your views. Dilshod
t2.uzSample:
Til o'rganishda o'z yo'lingizni topish

Til o'rganishning son-sanoqsiz usullari mavjudligi sababli, talabalar ko'pincha qaysi yondashuv eng samarali ekanligiga qiziqishadi. Garchi yagona javob bo'lmasa-da, muayyan strategiyalar doimiy ravishda natija beradi.

Birinchidan, immersiya keng tarqalgan eng kuchli usul hisoblanadi. O'zingizni til bilan o'rab olish, ommaviy axborot vositalari, suhbatlar va sayohatlar orqali o'rganishni keskin tezlashtiradi.

Biroq, hamma ham xorijga sayohat qila olmaydi. Bunday hollarda, doimiy kundalik mashqlar juda muhimdir. Hatto kuniga 20 daqiqa ham vaqti-vaqti bilan bo'ladigan intensiv mashg'ulotlardan ko'ra yaxshiroq natija beradi.

Bundan tashqari, usullarni birlashtirish eng yaxshi natija beradi. Rasmiy darslar tuzilmani ta'minlaydi, ilovalar esa moslashuvchanlikni taklif qiladi. Ona tilida so'zlashuvchilar bilan gaplashish, faqat darsliklar orqali erishib bo'lmaydigan ravonlikni rivojlantiradi.

Qo'shimcha ravishda, o'rganish yoqimli bo'lishi kerak. Maqsadli tilda filmlarni tomosha qilish yoki kitoblarni o'qish mashqni ish kabi his qilmaydi.

Oxir oqibat, eng yaxshi usul - bu siz doimiy ravishda amal qiladigan usuldir. Motivatsiya va izchillik har qanday aniq texnikadan ko'ra muhimroqdir.

Men o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman.
Maktab yaxshi.
Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom.
Menimcha, universitetning bepul bo'lishi yaxshi. Chunki ko'p odamlar o'qishni xohlashadi.
Lekin bu hukumat uchun qiyin bo'lishi mumkin.
Odamlar uchun o'rganish muhim.

t2.uzSampleB1:
Hammaga salom,

Menimcha, universitet ta'limi hamma uchun bepul bo'lishi kerak. Men bunga ishonaman, chunki ta'lim odamlarning yaxshi ish topishi va hayotini yaxshilashi uchun juda muhim. Agar universitet bepul bo'lsa, ko'proq odamlar borishi mumkin, hatto ularning puli ko'p bo'lmasa ham.

Misol uchun, mening mamlakatimda ko'p odamlar universitetga borishga qurbi yetmaydi va bu adolatdan emas. Biroq, men hukumat uchun hamma narsani to'lash qiyin bo'lishi mumkinligini ham tushunaman. Ehtimol, ular uni arzonroq qilish yo'lini topishlari mumkin, shunda ko'proq odamlar bora oladi.

Mening fikrimcha, ta'lim huquq, imtiyoz emas. O'qiganingiz uchun rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hammaga salom,

Universitet ta'limi hamma uchun bepul bo'lishi kerakmi degan savol murakkab bo'lib, har ikki tomonda ham asosli dalillar mavjud. Bir tomondan, universitetni bepul qilish, shubhasiz, kam ta'minlangan oilalardan chiqqan talabalar uchun imkoniyatlarni kengaytiradi, bu esa yanada adolatli jamiyat va malakali ishchi kuchiga olib keladi. Misol uchun, ko'plab iste'dodli shaxslar moliyaviy qiyinchiliklar tufayli hozirda oliy ma'lumot ololmaydilar, bu esa butun jamiyat uchun katta yo'qotishdir.

Biroq, bepul universitet ta'limining moliyaviy oqibatlari sezilarli. Hukumatlar moliyalashtirishning muqobil manbalarini topishlari kerak bo'ladi, ehtimol soliqlar oshishi yoki boshqa davlat xizmatlariga qisqartirishlar orqali. Bundan tashqari, bepul ta'lim ko'proq odamlar uni olganligi sababli diplomlarning qadrsizlanishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

Oxir oqibat, muvozanatli yondashuv zarur. Ehtimol, daromadga bog'liq kreditlar yoki stipendiyalar tizimi soliq to'lovchilarga ortiqcha yuklamasdan talabalarga moliyaviy yordam ko'rsatishi mumkin. Maqsad har bir insonning ijtimoiy-iqtisodiy kelib chiqishidan qat'i nazar, o'z salohiyatini to'liq ro'yobga chiqarish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishini ta'minlash bo'lishi kerak.

t12.title: formal letter · to director
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the school director. Write about your feelings and what you think the school should do.
t12.sample:
Dear School Director,

Thank you for seeking student feedback. I am happy to share my thoughts on the courses.

Firstly, the teaching methods have been highly effective. The teachers are knowledgeable and use engaging activities.

However, I feel the class sizes are somewhat large. Smaller groups would allow more individual attention and speaking opportunities.

Additionally, I would suggest adding more conversation clubs outside regular classes. This would help students practice in a relaxed environment.

Furthermore, providing access to online resources for self-study would be beneficial.

Thank you for your commitment to improving our learning experience.

Kind regards,
A Dedicated Student
t12.sampleA1:
Hi School Director,
I like school.
Teachers good.
More games, please.
Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Dear School Director,
I like the school, and the teachers are good. The classes are okay, but maybe too many people. I want to speak more.
We need more books and maybe films. Because it is fun.
Thank you.
t12.sampleB1:
Dear School Director,
I am writing to give you feedback on the courses. I think the teaching is good and the teachers are very helpful. However, I think the classes are a bit big. It's hard to speak sometimes because there are too many students.
I also think it would be good to have more activities. For example, maybe a conversation club or more trips. This would help us to practice our English more. Also, more books in the library would be helpful.
Thank you for listening to my feedback.
Yours sincerely,
A Student
t12.sampleB2: Dear Director, Thank you for inviting us to share our feedback at the end of the term. On the whole, I have really enjoyed the courses, and I would like to pass on a few thoughts. Firstly, the teaching methods have been excellent. The lessons are well planned and the activities keep everyone involved. However, I do feel that the classes are a little too large, which makes it hard to get enough speaking practice. Smaller groups would give each student more individual attention. I would also suggest setting up a weekly conversation club and providing access to online resources for self-study. These would let us keep practising outside lessons. Thank you for taking our opinions on board. I am sure these changes would make a real difference. Yours faithfully, Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli maktab direktori,

O'quvchilarning fikrini so'raganingiz uchun tashakkur. Kurslar haqida o'z fikrlarimni bildirishdan mamnunman.

Avvalo, o'qitish uslublari juda samarali bo'ldi. O'qituvchilar bilimdon va qiziqarli mashg'ulotlardan foydalanishadi.

Biroq, menimcha, sinf o'lchamlari biroz katta. Kichikroq guruhlar ko'proq individual e'tibor va nutq imkoniyatlarini beradi.

Bundan tashqari, darsdan tashqari suhbat klublarini ko'paytirishni taklif qilaman. Bu talabalarga erkin muhitda mashq qilishga yordam beradi.

Shuningdek, mustaqil o'rganish uchun onlayn resurslarga kirish imkoniyatini ta'minlash foydali bo'ladi.

Ta'lim olish tajribamizni yaxshilashga sodiqligingiz uchun rahmat.

Hurmat bilan,
Sizning sodiq o'quvchingiz

t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli maktab direktori,
Men sizga kurslar haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. O'qitish yaxshi va o'qituvchilar juda yordam beradi deb o'ylayman. Biroq, darslar biroz katta deb o'ylayman. Ba'zan gapirish qiyin, chunki talabalar juda ko'p.
Shuningdek, ko'proq tadbirlar bo'lishi yaxshi bo'lardi deb o'ylayman. Misol uchun, ehtimol, suhbat klubi yoki ko'proq sayohatlar. Bu bizga ingliz tilimizni ko'proq mashq qilishimizga yordam beradi. Shuningdek, kutubxonada ko'proq kitoblar bo'lishi foydali bo'lardi.
Fikrlarimni tinglaganingiz uchun rahmat.
Hurmat bilan,
Bir talaba
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli maktab direktori,
Men sizning til kurslari bo'yicha fikr-mulohazalaringizni so'rab qilgan murojaatingizga javoban yozmoqdaman. Umuman olganda, o'qitish uslublari juda samarali ekanligini aniqladim va o'qituvchilarning darslarni qiziqarli qilishga qaratgan sa'y-harakatlarini qadrlayman.
Biroq, menimcha, sinf hajmi bo'yicha yaxshilanishga ehtiyoj bor. Logistik qiyinchiliklarni tushunsam ham, kichikroq sinflar shaxsiy e'tibor va talabalarning ishtiroki uchun ko'proq imkoniyatlarni yaratadi deb o'ylayman. Bundan tashqari, hozirgi hajm ba'zan chuqurroq muhokamalarga to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin.
Bundan tashqari, men suhbat amaliyotiga qaratilgan ko'proq sinfdan tashqari mashg'ulotlarni joriy etishni taklif qilaman. Ehtimol, har haftalik til almashinuvi yoki mavzuli munozara guruhlari. Bu talabalarga o'z nutq ko'nikmalarini oshirish va ishonchni mustahkamlash uchun kamroq rasmiy muhitni ta'minlaydi.
Nihoyat, til o'rganish platformalari yoki raqamli kutubxonalar kabi onlayn resurslarga kengroq kirish o'z-o'zini yo'naltirgan holda o'rganish uchun qimmatli aktiv bo'ladi.
Takliflarimni ko'rib chiqayotganingiz uchun tashakkur. Ishonchim komilki, bu o'zgarishlar barcha talabalar uchun o'rganish tajribasini yanada oshiradi.
Hurmat bilan,
Talaba
